# Decisions and open points
On 10 October, the team approved a 30-day pilot only. Renewal is not approved.
Vendor can offer daily exports at $1,800/month or hourly exports at $2,250/month. Finance's cap is $2,000/month. Operations needs exports no less often than every four hours. Nora owns the budget call; Lee owns the SLA check.
The vendor promised a written SLA before the meeting but has not sent it.
